pairs.subject: settings
pairs.evidence: src/components/dashboard/views/settings/settings-sections/NotificationsCard.tsx:78 Toggles on this settings surface save instantly through settingsStore. That store hydrates by casting the parsed JSON without checking it, ignores a failed persist without telling anyone, and writes the whole document back from a fixed member list, so a write can fail while the switch still shows it saved, and a corrupt value can reach the surface unchecked.

techniques.evidence: src/stores/settingsStore.ts:75 If the localStorage write fails, the toggle stays flipped with no error shown and quietly reverts on reload. The standard's rule is that a failed write must say so (failure-not-empty-success).

src/stores/settingsStore.ts:100 Stored values are cast, never parsed or validated (weeklyDigest could load as a string, and unknown alertSeverity members are spread into state). A parse failure is swallowed at :108 ('ignore — defaults apply') with no telemetry. The sibling reviewStore validates its escalation policy field by field, so the repo already has the right pattern.

src/stores/settingsStore.ts:73 The whole store is one document, read once and written whole. Each save rebuilds it from the three members this build knows, so a top-level member written by a newer or older build is lost on the next toggle. Observers are fine because zustand setState patches in place.

src/stores/settingsStore.ts:95 Good: one bulk read of the namespace at module load, and setters write through. Missing: any decision about other writers. There is no storage-event listener and no stated staleness bound, so cross-window staleness is just whatever the code does. The technique calls that implicit position the indefensible one.

src/stores/settingsStore.ts:29 Keys are a closed TS vocabulary, so a typo is a compile error. Weaker on the store side: hydration does not reject unknown stored members, and providerOverrides is an open id-keyed map.
src/stores/settingsStore.ts:45 Overrides sit on top of a code or mock constant default, not a live environment source, so the precondition does not hold.

pairs.subject: settings
pairs.evidence: src/components/dashboard/views/knowledge/index.tsx:60 The only thing this context persists is the selected view tab (KNOWLEDGE_VIEW_KEY in localStorage, checked by isViewVariant). That is view-state ergonomics, which the golden path's boundary assigns to client-state. Searching the context for settingsStore, preference and DEFAULTS found nothing, so there is no application settings store here.

techniques.evidence: src/components/dashboard/views/knowledge/index.tsx:66 The view-tab read is guarded by a type check, but it is client view state, not a setting.
